name: muscle-memory
description: Browser extension that gives Figma back your browser's shortcuts, a real right-click, and a wheel that scrolls the way you expect.

scripts.check: node scripts/check-assets.mjs && for f in src/*.js test/*.test.js scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && npm test
scripts.package: rm -f muscle-memory.zip && zip -rq muscle-memory.zip manifest.json src icons -x '*.DS_Store' && node scripts/check-package.mjs muscle-memory.zip
scripts.check:icons: cd tools/icons && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked -- -D warnings && cargo run --locked --release && cd ../.. && { [ -z "$(git status --porcelain -- icons)" ] || { echo 'the generator no longer matches the committed icons'; git status --porcelain -- icons; exit 1; }; }
